meta.title: KARENWOOD | Luxury Wood Industry Holding & Architectural Atelier
meta.description: KARENWOOD is an award-winning luxury wood industry holding featuring 10 specialized ateliers across bespoke kitchens, spa bathrooms, pivot doors, interior decor, parquet flooring, cantilevered stairs, executive offices, and outdoor timber structures.

hero.subtitle: Synthesizing Scandinavian minimalism, Japanese wabi-sabi philosophy, and European precision engineering across ten specialized woodworking ateliers — from monolithic walnut kitchens and Hinoki spa sanctuaries to monumental pivot doors.

intro.title: Ten Specialized Ateliers. One Uncompromising Standard of Craft.
intro.lead: At Karenwood, timber is never merely a surface material; it is a living chronicle of decades in the forest, elevated by master joiners and 5-axis CNC robotics into enduring architectural heritage.
intro.body: We control the entire value chain of luxury woodwork: from selecting FSC-certified heritage logs and computer-monitored vacuum kiln seasoning, to traditional nail-free mortise-and-tenon joinery and zero-VOC botanical oil finishes.

pillars.title: Scandinavian Minimalism
pillars.desc: Pure architectural silhouettes, tactile honesty, and effortless spatial harmony.

pillars.title: Japanese Wabi-Sabi Soul
pillars.desc: Reverence for organic grain, natural knots, and noble patina that deepens over decades.

pillars.title: Generational Engineering
pillars.desc: Hydro-thermal stabilization and precision engineering backed by a 25-year written warranty.

subsidiariesSection.title: 10 Specialized Holding Subsidiaries
subsidiariesSection.subtitle: Each Karenwood division operates as a dedicated architectural atelier with its own engineering team, timber inventory, and master craftsmen.

featuredProjects.title: Signature Architectural Commissions
featuredProjects.subtitle: Discover residential sanctuaries, private estates, and executive landmarks crafted by Karenwood's specialized ateliers.

process.title: The 5-Stage Creation Process: From Forest to Estate
process.subtitle: Uniting timber science with hand-planed artisan joinery across five transparent milestones.

steps.title: Timber Selection & Vacuum Kiln Seasoning
steps.desc: Hand-selecting heritage Walnut, Oak, Teak, and Hinoki logs from sustainable forests and stabilizing moisture to exactly 8% in vacuum kilns.

steps.title: 3D LiDAR Scanning & BIM Grain Mapping
steps.desc: Sub-millimeter laser site surveying and full 3D grain-matched digital twins before a single saw blade touches the timber.

steps.title: 5-Axis CNC Precision & Kumiko Hand-Joinery
steps.desc: Pairing micron-level German CNC milling with traditional Japanese mortise-and-tenon and butterfly joinery without visible fasteners.

steps.title: Silk Hand-Sanding & Botanical Nano-Oils
steps.desc: Multi-stage artisan sanding followed by deep saturation with cold-pressed linseed oil, beeswax, and hydrophobic nano-resins.

steps.title: White-Glove Installation & Heritage Certificate
steps.desc: Dust-free acoustic installation by our in-house master fitters, accompanied by a numbered Timber Provenance Certificate and 25-year warranty.

testimonials.title: Trusted by Visionary Architects & Private Patrons

items.quote: For the Zafaraniyeh Penthouse, achieving seamless grain continuity across the monolithic black walnut kitchen, the 4-meter pivot entrance door, and the chevron parquet floor was only possible through Karenwood's integrated holding ateliers. Their finish rivals Milan's finest houses.
items.author: Dr. Farhad Majidinia

items.quote: The Hinoki cypress soaking tub and spa vanity Karenwood crafted for our Lavasan villa still release their calming natural cedar aroma four years later. Their waterproof hydro-thermal engineering is extraordinary.
items.author: Eng. Roxana Pashaei
items.project: Lavasan Sanctuary Villa — Spa Bathroom & Pergola

items.quote: Our cantilevered helical staircase and parametric acoustic boardroom walls have become the architectural centerpiece of our headquarters. Invisible joinery and punctual delivery make Karenwood our premier partner.
items.author: Eng. Saman Dolatshahi
items.project: Jordan Flagship Tower — Executive Office & Staircase
